generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

Liquid assets or availability of credit facilities of no less than Rs.13.04 Lakhs (Credit lines/letter of credit/certificates form banks for meeting the fund requirement etc. (not less than 30% of 5th year of O&M cost) (Unconditional LOC)

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The bid is to be submitted through GOK k-Portal platform https://kppp.karnataka.gov.in only.

The Tenderer should obtain tender documents through K-portal web site (https://kppp.karnataka.gov.in at free of cost. Additional conditions and information also can be obtained through the above mentioned website
Tender application cost will not be refundable or exchangeable in case of cancellation of tender
Contractor should made an agreement within 20 days of tender acceptance without fail, other wise the tender will be rejected.
Corrigendum/Addendum modifications/correction, If any, will be published in the website only.
The contractor has to make his own arrangement for procurement of all materials required for the work. There is no departmental supply of materials.
Acceptance or Cancellation of the works or tender are reserved by Executive Engineer without giving any reasons for the same.

Security deposit (FSD) at the rate of 5% on the amount quoted by the contractor. If the amount quoted is lesser than the amount put to tender, the difference cost should be paid by the contractor, in favour of Executive Engineer in the form of DD/FDR at the time of Work Order.
Conditional tender will not be considered

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent.
After the Completion of the O & M should be duly handed over to the department with all records and equipments.

Staff requirements should be according to the Sanctioned Estimates. Staff attendance register should be duly maintained at the site by the contractor and should be produced at the time of visit by the department officer.
Vehicle requirements should be according to the Sanctioned Estimate.
Log Book of machineries should be maintained for all works.
Contractor name and mobile number shall be displayed at the site such as WTP , IPS, OHT and all GP offices.
The bidder rate should be qoute without GST

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Operation & Maintenance of MVWSS to BILAKI& other 03 Villages in Bhadravathi Taluk Of Shivamogga District

itemList.description: Repairs, Operation and Maintenance for 1 st yearA Establishment Operation and Maintenance of the scheme as per TOR which includes, Providing Sufficient technical staff such as Supervisor- 01nos, pump operators- 02 nos, helpers-1 nos, valveman 2nos, electrician/mechanic-2 no & watchman 1no etc. who are required to run the system Labor charges includes PF employers contribution 12%, ESI employers contribution @1.75% & Service tax @12% in complete manner and providing all material & chemical required for operation of Jack well /pipeline repair works. 1) Regular maintenance of civil structures like floating plat form WTP PWS, Master Balancing tank, pump house and other civil structures .The maintenance consist all kinds of repairs to damaged structures, cleaning and washing and painting civil structures once in a year .all the infrastructures must be maintained in good working condition through out the year so as to ensure uninterrupted water supply to all the habitations throughout the year. Operation and Maintenance Maintaining the quality of water as per guidelines CPHEEO manual and ISI specification including cost of testing of water at laboratory twice in a month and generating the reports duly submitting to the division. 3) Operation and Maintenance of all kinds of pumping machineries: Operation and maintenance of pumping machineries established in intermediate sump, and other mechanical components of the scheme with due care by pump operators duly lubricating, greasing with all required care and should run the pumps satisfactorily including electrical maintenance covering all repairs replacement of electrical cable/switch board, replacement of burnt parts of machinery. Replacement of all parts of machinery will be carried out as per the direction of the engineer in charge for satisfactory functioning of the scheme to provide the designed discharge of drinking water to all the habitations of the project. 4)Transportation and Communication Charges: Transportation Charges include cost of mobilization of staff for satisfactory functioning of all pumps, Sumps all other components of scheme. a) The GP or VWSC/concerned section officer of the project certify the satisfactory functioning of the scheme and based on this payment will be made to the contractor. b)The contractor should maintain a log book on the working of all pumping machineries, intermediate sumps including day today records of units consumed per day. The payment will be made by the Engineer in charges for satisfactory report of every month end (the GP secretary and SO in charges of WSS should give satisfactory report) subject to condition appended in TOR

Providing Collecting , transportation , loading , unloading, washed course sand at site of work as per direction of Engineer -in charge of work. (UNI-SR, VOL-I, Sl. No - 73, Pg No-A-41) (Basic Rate of Sand - 1764.00 Rs )

Labour charges for laying filter media in all depth as per specifications in infiltration gallery works including cleaning, screening and placing it under water with all lead & lift to the point of laying etc., complete and as per the direction of the Engineer -in -charge of work, Coursed Sand passing through a sieve of 4 meshes 2.5cms. And retained on a sieve of 10 meshes to 2.5 cms. And filling it under water and coursed sand passing through a sieve of 10 meshes to 2.5 cms. And retainded on 20 meshes to 2.5cms. And filling it under water.
Removal of failed sand from slow sand filter.
